bytecode_policy: one private pycache prefix per comparison; both sources and dependency closures prewarmed with writes enabled; measured fresh interpreters read warm bytecode with writes disabled

gc_policy.operations: cyclic collector disabled outside timing clocks; original state restored after clocks even on failure; allocation and reference-count cleanup retained; setup and oracles outside timing; no per-case collection
gc_policy.cold_imports: fresh interpreter default cyclic collector state

publication_normalization.note: Consumer labels, artifact paths and machine-specific origins normalized for public publication. Historical timings, measured payload bytes and original source digests retain their captured meaning; normalized source/archive bytes have their own publication hashes.
